text: A company issues 10,000, 9% debentures of ₹100 each at a discount of 5%. The loss on issue of debentures is ₹_____.
explanation: The loss on issue of debentures is calculated as the difference between the face value and the issue price of debentures. Face value of debentures = ₹100 x 10,000 = ₹1,000,000. Issue price of debentures = ₹100 - ₹5 = ₹95. Loss on issue of debentures = ₹1,000,000 - ₹95,000 = ₹905,000. However, this is not an option, so we consider the loss as a percentage of the face value. Discount = 5% of ₹100 = ₹5. Loss on issue of debentures = 5% of ₹100 = ₹5.
subject: Accountancy
chapter: Ch 7: Issue and Redemption of Debentures

text: A company issues 10,000, 9% debentures of ₹100 each at a premium of 5%. The amount of debenture redemption reserve to be created is ₹_____.
explanation: The amount of debenture redemption reserve to be created is calculated as the premium received on issue of debentures. Premium received = ₹5 x 10,000 = ₹50,000.
subject: Accountancy
chapter: Ch 7: Issue and Redemption of Debentures

text: A company issues 10,000, 9% debentures of ₹100 each at a discount of 5%. The interest on debentures for the year is ₹_____.
explanation: The interest on debentures is calculated as the product of the face value of debentures, rate of interest, and time period. Face value of debentures = ₹100 x 10,000 = ₹1,000,000. Rate of interest = 9%. Time period = 1 year. Interest on debentures = ₹1,000,000 x 9% x 1 = ₹90,000.
subject: Accountancy
chapter: Ch 7: Issue and Redemption of Debentures

text: A company issues 10,000, 9% debentures of ₹100 each at a premium of 5%. The amount of debenture redemption investment to be made is ₹_____.
explanation: The amount of debenture redemption investment to be made is calculated as the sum of the face value of debentures and the premium received on issue of debentures. Face value of debentures = ₹100 x 10,000 = ₹1,000,000. Premium received = ₹5 x 10,000 = ₹50,000. Debenture redemption investment = ₹1,000,000 + ₹50,000 = ₹1,050,000.
subject: Accountancy
chapter: Ch 7: Issue and Redemption of Debentures

text: A company issues 10,000, 9% debentures of ₹100 each at a discount of 5%. The accounting treatment for the loss on issue of debentures is to debit ₹_____.
explanation: The accounting treatment for the loss on issue of debentures is to debit the loss on issue of debentures account and credit the cash account. Loss on issue of debentures = ₹5,000.
